plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Live session dashboard, changed-files, notes and timer panes, context band with quick replies, and /sessionrecap

plugins.name: tool-guard
plugins.description: Blocks risky tool calls, badges commands by risk, and shows a pass/fail card under test runs

plugins.name: look-and-sound
plugins.description: Sound cues when a turn finishes or fails (the Dusk ink theme is off)

plugins.name: prompt-tools
plugins.description: Right-click prompt shortcuts, /audit, and standing prompt preferences

plugins.name: looks
plugins.description: A /look picker: no theme by default, then opt-in palettes (paper, nord, solarized, sepia, high contrast, seasons, time of day, per project, per model) and subtle moving backdrops

plugins.name: motion
plugins.description: Calm motion for the interface: eased gauges, number tickers, status typing and pulse, tool-row shimmer and check pops, spring timer ring, idle breathing, test celebration, and a /motion on|off switch

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: One tabbed cockpit pane (overview, tool timeline, files, todo, history, errors, links, palette) plus a git/spend band, forecasts, shelves and pins

plugins.name: tool-visuals
plugins.description: Richer tool-call rows: risk edge, file glyphs, mini diffs, duration and size chips, network badges and progress, secret masking, retry counts, failing-test and build-error cards

plugins.name: sound-pack
plugins.description: Sound packs (retro, wood, glass) with finish chime, error tones, approval cue, optional ticks, spoken summaries, quiet hours and volume by turn length

plugins.name: safety-pro
plugins.description: Safety and power workflow: dry-run, allowlist, hard budget, loop breaker, protected paths, opt-in checkpoints with confirmed rollback, pre-commit check, auto-compact, handoff note and a block log

plugins.name: personality
plugins.description: Quiet, switchable fun: mood status, streaks, badges, a tiny pet, greeting, tip of the day, focus sprints and a weekly report (/fun on|off)

plugins.name: extras
plugins.description: Screen-share masking, away digest, smart alerts, prompt linter, session health, per-tool cost, replay scrubber, command cheatsheet, auto-title and a read-only snapshot browser

plugins.name: animations
plugins.description: Fourteen state-driven terminal animations (heartbeat, context tank, coin drop, sparkline draw-in, sliding tab underline, error shake, commit confetti, flip clock, badge flash, sky strip, skeleton shimmer, conveyor queue, ink-spread edits, ambient waves) on one shared ticker, with a lab pane and /anim

plugins.name: prompting
plugins.description: Prompt craft: templates, context blocks, macros, queue, A/B, scorecard, diff, reword, clean-up, tone and other standing instructions (all off by default). Commands start with pm; /pm lists them.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Review helper for code Claude changes: tickable checklist and 19 heuristic detectors (risky paths, test gaps, complexity, TODOs, dead code, naming, import cycles, API/dependency/config changes, error handling, logging, migrations, performance, accessibility, patch size) in one pane

plugins.name: debug-kit
plugins.description: Debugging helpers: failing-test focus, bisect guide, stack-trace explainer, repro recorder, flaky/coverage/timing/snapshot test insights, log tail, error clusters, hypothesis board, breadcrumbs, env snapshot, port finder, mock map, crash-loop and regression guards, postmortem draft

plugins.name: git-kit
plugins.description: Read-only git helpers: commit-style learner, branch names, PR drafts, changelog, status map, merge preview, stash/worktree/submodule views, repo health and merge readiness. Every command starts with gk.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Learning tools: glossaries, flashcards with spaced repetition, learning log, reading list, architecture map, skill tracker, explainer prompt-fillers and opt-in mentor, rubber-duck and beginner modes (/ln lists the commands)

plugins.name: layout
plugins.description: How things are drawn: zen mode, split view, floating note, sticky headers, collapsible sections, width and density controls, error and long-output banners, icon packs and a colour legend

plugins.name: alerts
plugins.description: One quiet notifier for this mod's notices: priority levels, digest, snooze, quiet hours, per-category mute, history, waiting-on-you band, deadline, cost, rate-limit, context, idle, disk and network alerts (all /al commands)

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Searchable notes archive: per-folder notes with tags, links, snippets, command cookbook, daily journal, reminders, recurring tasks, backup and restore (commands start with nt)

plugins.name: controls
plugins.description: Trust and transparency: what every mod can do, outbound-host and folder ledgers, rule tester, temporary allow, per-project profiles, incident mode and a guard self-test, around tool-guard and safety-pro

plugins.name: delight
plugins.description: Small delights, all off by default except the gallery and /dl help: theme and sound of the week, fortune cookies, mini-games, pet wardrobe preview, milestone postcards, rare compliments, mod gallery, tour, changelog and usage heat (/dl lists the commands)

plugins.name: settings
plugins.description: Shared look-and-feel settings (accent, density, icons, preset) that other mods can read; /cfg to change them

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: A palette and style library you apply on demand with /skuse: 15 named palettes, an accent picker, contrast steps, rounded or square corners, glass cards and a paper grain. Nothing is applied by default

plugins.name: skins-plus
plugins.description: More looks, opt-in only: cyber, cozy night, high-visibility, print, weekday, per-project and per-branch tints, a look scheduler, sunrise accent, custom roles, theme import/export, dyslexia and large-type settings, a custom status line template

plugins.name: charts
plugins.description: Twenty text charts (donut gauges, 24h clock, treemap, heatmap, Gantt, flame, mini-map, radar, scatter, burndown and more) in one tabbed pane, drawn with block, braille and box characters from this session's recorded tool calls

plugins.name: charts-more
plugins.description: More text charts (histogram, box plot, context ring, thermometer, fuel gauge, speedometer, battery, tag cloud, note network, folder tree, area, candlestick, pie bar, before/after slider) in one picker pane, with quiet state-driven animations

plugins.name: assist
plugins.description: Quiet helpers that fill the prompt box and never send: next-step chips, stuck detector, explain-error chip, retry, context compressor, smart paste label, file finder, command recall, recap, pre/post-flight checklists, bug-report and handoff drafts, reading time, skimmer, question bank, shortcut coach, error museum and fix library (all /as commands)

plugins.name: assist-more
plugins.description: More helpers: environment doctor, project card, run-books, time estimates, split and decide helpers, risk and typo nudges, undo guide, plain-language mode, contrast checker, profiles, quiet hours, own sounds, sprite and goals. Every command starts with am (/am lists them).

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: Progress and achievement: goals with a daily bar, weekly ring and confetti, milestone ladder, XP, streak calendar with freeze days, projects and checklists, learning, skill tree, habits, personal bests, journal, focus and momentum, backlog, ship log and test metrics (all /pg commands)

plugins.name: progress-more
plugins.description: Progress extras in one pane: quality trend, review bar, refactor/migration/upgrade trackers, test debt, docs coverage, cleanup meter, intentions, wrap/plan/win/share cards, season goals, and your own tips, prompt templates, toast rules, retention, tiles and number formats

plugins.name: anim-more
plugins.description: Twenty more calm, state-driven terminal animations (pop-in hint, breathing glow, underline draw, button squish, staged toast, wave, spinners, typewriter, marquee, pulsing badge, spend drip, growing plant, rain, fireworks, balloons, page flip, dial, pendulum, walking pet, rocket) on one shared ticker, with a lab pane at /aylab and /ay

plugins.name: anim-extra
plugins.description: Settings hub pane (every mod's help command, presets, enable/disable list, aliases, band order), extra animations (skeleton, ripple, urgent edge glow, day-night strip, reduced-motion previews), and customizing: language, thresholds, file glyphs, alert rule builder, recipes, mod ratings (all /ax commands)

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Front door for a collection of mods and other Claude plugins: catalog, installed list, bundles, remote update check, and install/enable/disable/update/uninstall command lines you can copy or run after a two-step confirm

plugins.name: visuals
plugins.description: Real vector dashboards for the desktop app: smooth animated rings, sparklines, bars and heat strips drawn as SVG, with a static version for reduced motion

plugins.name: band-tidy
plugins.description: Tidies the area above the prompt: keeps a short list of rows, hides the rest, and lets you choose with /tidy

plugins.name: prefs
plugins.description: A second set of shared preferences (formats, language, time zone, toasts, charts, data, per-mod tables) that other mods can read from one atom, with formatting helpers, a Preferences pane, import and export, undo, per-project and per-branch layers, and work/home/demo profiles; /pf

plugins.name: finish-kit
plugins.description: A style studio: live vector previews of finishes (grays, tones, surfaces, type, data palettes, icons) on sample cards, and commands that apply a finish with one theme call. Nothing is applied until you type a command

plugins.name: style-gallery
plugins.description: A design-system gallery: one pane with 30 labelled style samples (radius, elevation, badges, toasts, modes, navigation patterns) drawn as vector images on the desktop and as text elsewhere, with /sgcopy to put a short written spec of any style in the prompt box

plugins.name: layout-kit
plugins.description: A customizable dashboard builder: one pane of tiles (calls, errors, files, spend, context, time, todos and your own text, number and formula tiles) with named pages, saved and per-project layouts, snippets, aliases, templates, rules, badges and goals. Affects only its own pane.

plugins.name: custom-two
plugins.description: Customizing, part two: colours per file type, a branch accent, event sounds, greetings and tips, empty states and pane titles, date ranges, saved filters and searches, report templates and exports, a hotkey map, a theme from a logo colour, icon sets, easing curves, a look schedule, focus modes, do-not-disturb, row-hiding rules, bundles, a checklist, a glossary and macros

plugins.name: control-kit
plugins.description: Control surface for the other mods: one master quiet switch with exact restore, panic and safe mode, pause or snooze a mod for a while, previews and two-step confirms for bulk changes, undo, a read-only lock, a command palette, a permission summary, an audit log, a Bash block list, row pinning and ordering (/kc)

plugins.name: control-two
plugins.description: Quick controls and diagnostics: toggles for motion, calm, sounds and recording, row visibility rules, backups and restore of your feature switches, a two-step reset, read-only update checks, health lights, error log, hook timing and order, storage meter, command conflicts, dependency graph, changelog, diagnostics text and notes per mod (prefix kx)

plugins.name: ui-kit
plugins.description: Six views over what this session did (timeline, files treemap, errors, prompts, spend, activity) in one switchable pane: real vector charts on the desktop app, text charts elsewhere, with split view, master-detail, mini and widget modes, breakpoints, accordions, a stepper, optimistic updates and undo

plugins.name: ui-two
plugins.description: One pane with a view switcher: command bar, popover menu, activity feed, timeline, kanban, table, cards, calendar, treemap, graph, compare, replay, notices, print and presentation views, budget guard with rollover, forecast, prompt library with stats, model log, digest, goals, pomodoro and focus score

plugins.name: add-kit
plugins.description: Project and code companion: repo scorecard, test/flaky/coverage/build/error trends, TODO board, command history, snippets, dependency and hygiene checks, ports and processes, log tail, distraction log, meeting and presentation modes. Read-only shell only. Every command starts with ad.

plugins.name: add-two
plugins.description: Git graph, release notes and changelog, PR checklist, docs search, disk usage, onboarding and cheatsheets, plus learning tools (paths, flashcards, quiz, glossary), design logs, handoff pack, mod ratings, theme gallery and a sharing guide. Read-only shell, no network. Every command starts with ae.

plugins.name: helpers
plugins.description: Quiet helpers: plain-words approvals, delete preview, secret and commit guards, changes and steps panels, time and cost under replies, welcome-back summary, right-click extras, notes and /quietmode

plugins.name: sidekick
plugins.description: Claim checker, loose ends, standing rules, prompt queue, daily summary, project card, running servers, file rewind, sensitive-file and branch warnings, right-click teach and prove
